data.title: Accuray Completes Major Financing Transaction with TCW
data.description:
Accuray ( (ARAY) ) has issued an announcement.

On November 13, 2026, Accuray announced it had completed its financing transaction with TCW, its primary lender and largest shareholder. TCW exchanged $40 million of term-loan principal and its $15 million cash investment for Series A convertible preferred stock, while certain financial covenants were waived through December 31, 2027 and a delayed-draw loan of up to $5 million remained available subject to conditions.

Accuray also completed a 1-for-40 reverse stock split effective November 9, 2026, following stockholder approval on October 6, and increased its authorized common-stock shares before the split. The transaction reduced board size from eight to seven, gave TCW the right to appoint two directors, and automatically canceled warrants covering approximately 27.6 million pre-split common shares.

data.title: Otello Reports Share Buyback Transactions
data.description:
The latest update is out from Otello Corporation ASA ( (GB:0FI5) ).

Pareto Securities AS purchased 175,814 shares on behalf of Otello Corporation ASA from 9 to 13 November 2026, at an average price of NOK 17.76 and a total value of NOK 3,122,804. data.title: Zijin Mining Adjusts Exercise Price Under 2023 Share Option Scheme
data.description:
Zijin Mining Group Co ( (HK:2899) ) has provided an announcement.

Zijin Mining Group Co. said its board approved an adjustment to the exercise price under its 2023 Share Option Incentive Scheme on 12 November 2026, under authorisations granted by shareholders. Directors with connected relationships abstained from voting.

The adjustment followed completed cash dividend distributions of RMB0.38 per share for the year ended 31 December 2025 and RMB0.42 per share for the six months ended 30 June 2026, both including tax. The scheme provides that exercise prices must be adjusted for profit distributions, while the release does not state the revised exercise price.

data.title: Kolibri Global Energy Reports Nine-Month 2026 Oil and Gas Revenue of $60.421 Million
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Kolibri Global Energy ( (KGEI) ).

On November 13, 2026, Kolibri Global Energy furnished a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim financial statements and management’s discussion for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The filing reported nine-month oil and natural gas revenue, net of royalties, of $60.421 million, compared with $42.116 million in the same period of 2025.

For the third quarter of 2026, oil and natural gas revenue, net of royalties, was $18.310 million, compared with $14.956 million a year earlier. At September 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were $4.384 million, total assets were $327.565 million and loans and borrowings were $54.786 million.

data.title: Meysu Gida Filing Lists Two Independent Board Members
data.description:
An announcement from Meysu Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. ( (TR:MEYSU) ) is now available.

The filing lists Meysu Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.’s board structure, with Bekir Güldüoğlu as executive chairman and Mehmet Güldüoğlu as non-executive deputy chairman. Orhan Güldüoğlu and Osman Güldüoğlu are listed as dependent board members, with Osman also serving as general manager.

Mehmet Kalem and Birol Ülker Güney are listed as independent members, with a first election date of June 9, 2026. Kalem chairs the Early Detection of Risk Committee and serves on the Audit and Corporate Governance committees, while Güney chairs the Audit and Corporate Governance committees and serves on the risk committee.

data.title: Thorium Space Completes SUBCOM Rocket Field Tests
data.description:
Thorium Space S.A. ( (PL:THS) ) has issued an update.

Thorium Space S.A. is headquartered in Wrocław and develops communication, positioning and tracking systems for the space and defense sectors. It leads SUBCOM in cooperation with Łukasiewicz–ILOT.

Field tests at Ustka verified Thorium Space equipment during an ILR-33 BURSZTYN 2K suborbital rocket flight at approximately Mach 2, covering communication, positioning and tracking systems, transceiver modules, antennas, rocket-to-ground data transmission and telecommands. Results confirmed the telemetry communication system, tracking system and tracking algorithm; the ground station tracked the rocket, received telemetry and transmitted telecommands during flight.

data.title: Torex Semiconductor Reports Six-Month Net Sales and Profit Growth
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Torex Semiconductor Ltd. ( (JP:6616) ).

TOREX SEMICONDUCTOR LTD. reported consolidated net sales of ¥13,876 million for the six months ended September 30, 2026, up 16.8% year over year. Operating profit increased 256.5% to ¥1,477 million, ordinary profit rose 301.4% to ¥1,529 million, and profit attributable to owners of the parent increased 529.0% to ¥2,116 million.

As of September 30, 2026, the company reported total assets of ¥37,331 million and net assets of ¥20,742 million, compared with ¥35,801 million and ¥18,761 million, respectively, as of March 31, 2026. The equity-to-asset ratio was 55.6%, compared with 52.4% at March 31, 2026.
